scope: Full source review; implementation proposals, not new analysis authority or measured speed.

insights.llvm: mergeIn widens possible values across alternative paths; intersect combines facts about the same value at the same program location.
insights.ink: Facts currently combines known bits and unsigned intervals locally; choose joins alternatives conservatively. Future branch facts must use intersection only within the exact checked branch scope, and union at joins.
insights.action: General path-scoped range/bit candidate discovery with proof-producing database conditions; do not mistake mutually exclusive branch predicates for simultaneous assumptions.

insights.llvm: Optional range-extension counting widens to overdefined after a bounded number of changes.
insights.ink: Current word analysis walks a bounded expression tree; it is not a loop fixed-point solver.
insights.action: For future loop facts, monotone transfer and explicit widening should degrade to unknown candidates rather than invent stronger invariants. Measure proof yield against budget.

insights.llvm: Unknown, undef, overdefined, constants and possibly-undef ranges are distinct; singletons with undef use LLVM replacement rules.
insights.ink: Default Facts describes all possible concrete Ink words. Ink wrapping arithmetic and masked shift counts must not inherit LLVM undef/poison/nowrap reasoning.
insights.action: Keep unreachable/unvisited/unknown states separate if flow analysis is added. Derive rules from fixed Ink semantics and replay proof evidence.

insights.llvm: Equal constants can still have distinct pointer provenance; merges propagate a conservative provenance marker.
insights.ink: Scalar numerical facts cannot establish borrowing, storage aliasing or checked layout invariants.
insights.action: Retain source-bound ownership/effect provenance separately from value equality when extending physical planning.

insights.llvm: Integer constants use singleton ranges, comparisons use full-range relations, and intersection deliberately permits imprecise conservative outcomes.
insights.ink: Facts reduces unsigned intervals and known-bit prefixes; carry, wrapping and feasible shift residues are explicit.
insights.action: Add future relational precision through ordinary proved laws; do not treat stronger abstract estimates as compiler equality authority.

remaining: Implement and evaluate scoped fact discovery where source semantics and proof machinery support it.
Audit full LLVM ConstantRange implementation and users before adopting modular interval operations.
Broader loop/alias source review and actual held-out workload measurement remain open.
